correctness.rationale: A direct equivalence establishes the 2-domination predicate. The already-proved t+1 maximum gives exact excess <=4; every possible multiset of nonsingleton occupancies is enumerated by an exact finite checker at all 12 base pairs. The separate two-singleton stabilization proof makes these finite checks exhaustive for all t. The factorial counts are derived from orbit-stabilizer counting and checked by direct enumeration of labeled set partitions for (3,4),(4,5),(5,6). The bundled checker was executed successfully and can be replayed from the package.

value.rationale: A complete structural and multiplicity classification of all extremizers sharpens an established scalar result in three full infinite graph regimes. The exact transition from 3t and 10t to a cubic 25t+15t(t−1)(t−2) is explained by the mixed two-hub optimizer type, whose existence as one witness was previously known but whose total multiplicity was not enumerated, giving usable combinatorial counts rather than a routine numerical increment. Finite enumeration is paired with a mathematical stabilization proof.
